title: Export citations and reproducible research packets
objective: Source selections can be cited and handed to another researcher or agent.
outcome: Citations are generated from publisher, product, release, canonical locator and observed/accessed dates. Absent DOI, authors, license or year are marked not captured and are not invented. Exports exclude credentials and default to source evidence only. Question and private notes are included only when the user explicitly chooses. Imported packets keep source order and generation; a retired generation is typed and does not silently re-run a different search. A cited source is the publisher product; USHSO verification is identified separately. plan_research remains disabled. worker/index.mjs does not import enrichment. HTTP 200 is not a completed research task. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Define citation formats
commits.instructions: Generate plain-text, BibTeX/RIS and machine-readable source citations from publisher, product, release, canonical locator and observed/accessed dates. Mark absent DOI/license data honestly.
commits.verification: Do not invent authors, DOI, release year or publisher endorsement; output escaping preserves special characters.

commits.subject: Export the evidence packet
commits.instructions: Include selected sources, contexts, fields, recipes, limitations and receipt links; let users explicitly choose whether to include their question/notes.
commits.verification: Exports exclude credentials and default to source evidence only; they validate against the versioned packet schema.

commits.subject: Verify re-import and citation fidelity
commits.instructions: Open an exported packet in a clean client and resolve retained contexts or typed retired-generation states. Provide a readable summary alongside JSON.
commits.verification: The exported source order and generation agree with the UI; reproducing a selection does not silently re-run a different search.
